decision.reason: [ev-7cea1050ccfe] is a single changelog line saying only that the Host and HostRegexp matchers were "reworked", filed under bug fixes. It points to PR #9559 but doesn't say what the before and after behaviour or syntax is, which router rules or configurations are affected, or what happens to an existing rule if the operator does nothing. To write the applicability and consequence aspects we need the PR description or the v3 migration/upgrade guide section on these matchers.
